name: play-button
title: Play button
subject: A game menu Play button with a notification badge, drawn in the kit's clean style (soft gradients, thin tinted edges) in the studio's amber.
intent: Every state a button lives through as a clip, timed for UI: quick, small anticipation, an overshoot sized for a button, every move readable at 160 px wide. The badge plays on track 1 over the idling button on track 0.

clips.name: idle
clips.does: a 2% breath with a short hold at the top, the triangle nudges forward once

clips.name: hover_in
clips.does: grows to 1.05 past a 1.07 peak, a shine sweeps the face, the glow comes up

clips.name: press
clips.does: squashes to 0.9 as the face sinks into its rim

clips.name: release
clips.does: springs to 1.08 and settles on 1.0, the face pops back up

clips.name: disabled
clips.does: swaps to the grey art and dims the label; nothing moves

clips.name: badge_pop
clips.does: the badge pops 0 to 1.15 to 1.0 with a wobble and a ring

clips.name: badge_pulse
clips.does: a dip, a pulse to 1.14 and a ring, then a rest
